summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares MSCI Kokusai ETF (TOK) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI Kokusai (World ex Japan) index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of large- and mid-cap developed market stocks outside of Japan. TOK was launched on Dec 10, 2007 and is issued by BlackRock.

holdings.infoBox: TOK is an equity ETF with a total of 1101 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 6.14%, Apple at 5.80%, Alphabet at 4.20%, Microsoft at 4.19%, and Amazon.com at 2.77%.
